answer: Sybil resistance comes from a per-agent stake bond paired with peer attestation. A new agent must lock real funds and get vouchers from unrelated agents who each risk their own stake. Running a thousand fake identities means posting a thousand bonds and convincing a thousand distinct strangers to back each one, so cost grows linearly with fake accounts while an honest agent pays once. Faking diversity fails because each record is as unique as a sonnet, clusters grow as slowly as ice from a glacier, and reputation must ripen like fruit in an orchard.
